name: Exp_TrendManager_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA implements the Trend Manager Plus strategy, using the TM (Trend Manager) indicator to identify trend direction and generate buy/sell signals. It enters trades when the TM indicator changes color, indicating a trend shift, and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了Trend Manager Plus策略，使用TM趋势管理指标来识别趋势方向并生成买卖信号。当TM指标颜色变化表明趋势转向时进场交易，并通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Trend Manager Plus指标，该指标通常结合了移动平均线和ATR（平均真实范围）来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当TM指标从下跌趋势转向上涨趋势时开多仓，从上涨趋势转向下跌趋势时开空仓。出场条件包括：达到设定的固定止盈/止损水平，或TM指标发出反向信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数供用户配置，但缺乏动态仓位调整和追踪止损机制。整体策略逻辑简单直观，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号导致频繁亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Trend Manager Plus indicator, which typically combines moving averages and ATR (Average True Range) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: open a long position when the TM indicator shifts from a downtrend to an uptrend, and open a short position when it shifts from an uptrend to a downtrend. Exit conditions include: reaching the configured fixed take profit or stop loss levels, or closing the position when the TM indicator issues a reverse signal. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a percentage-based calculation relative to the account balance. Money management provides users with configurable stop loss and take profit parameters, but lacks dynamic position sizing and trailing stop mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is simple and intuitive, suitable for markets with clear trending conditions, but may generate numerous false signals resulting in frequent losses during ranging or choppy markets.

parameters.description_en: EA unique ID to distinguish orders across instances

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和优化参数
基于趋势跟踪原则，在明显趋势市场中表现良好
提供可配置的止损止盈参数，用户可灵活调整风险敞口
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize parameters
Based on trend-following principles, performs well in clearly trending markets
Provides configurable stop loss and take profit parameters for flexible risk management
cons: 缺乏追踪止损功能（或仅提供基本功能），趋势中利润可能未能最大化
在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少仓位动态调整机制，无法根据市场波动率自动优化持仓规模
cons_en: Lacks trailing stop functionality (or provides only basic), potentially failing to maximize profits during trends
Prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Missing dynamic position sizing mechanism, unable to automatically optimize position size based on market volatility
improvements: 增加追踪止损功能以锁定趋势利润，减少回吐风险
添加市场波动率过滤器（如ADX或布林带带宽），在震荡行情中减少交易频率
实现基于ATR的动态仓位管理，根据当前市场波动自动调整交易手数
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to lock in trend profits and reduce giveback risk
Introduce a volatility filter (such as ADX or Bollinger Bandwidth) to reduce trading frequency during ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic position sizing to automatically adjust lot size according to current market volatility

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一根K线内多次开仓
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，高波动期止损可能过近导致频繁被扫
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility changes, tight stops may be frequently hit during high volatility periods
